fields.platform: Native Amiga/m68k, x86, x86-64, ARM, PowerPC, and Raspberry Pi AArch64 ports, plus hosted Linux/Unix and Apple Silicon macOS targets (including darwin-aarch64); per-port availability and hardware support vary.
fields.status: Active development; official July 2026 project notes report nearly 2,000 commits over the prior year, a new 64-bit AArch64 Raspberry Pi port, and a hosted darwin-aarch64 target for Apple Silicon. Official port documentation cautions that some actively developed targets are incomplete or not available for download.
